name: finops-dashboards
description: Designs, reviews and builds cost and FinOps dashboards: billing rules reproduced in code (Hetzner hourly-capped, OpenCost allocation and idle, LiteLLM spend, electricity, SaaS, VAT), one cost basis per panel, an answer-first layout with delta, forecast and budget, unit cost and showback, budget and anomaly alerts, Grafana specifics, a 24-rule dashboard linter and a forecast script.
